notes.title: Anubis Update Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/edff0f7ccf0944944bad5407901433abb2a4a6a0.png[/img]
[h2]
The Anubis Update is here![/h2]

[h1]A new permanent enemy: Anubis[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/7820e577a0bbe85b1fe0d9afd1469c591c856db8.png[/img]

Anubis is an Egyptian god of death rites and guide to the underworld.
His origin is not clear. According to some sources, he is the son of Osiris and according to others, a son of the god Re.
Anubis helped the goddess Isis to reassemble Osiris from corpse parts so that Osiris could ascend to his throne in the underworld.

He is a very powerful creature. Anubis is not evil, but he does not like it when people do not respect the peace of the dead.
We have probably incurred his wrath with our ghost hunts...
He is only visible in the underworld, but can also attack you from the underworld. To destroy him, you have to draw a portal on a wall with chalk and use an incantation to ask Osiris to open the portal to the underworld. Then you must
find an Anubis mask in the underworld and only then will Anubis be vulnerable with a knife.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/cfd54fe469e88e66aa329b5f8dc22328e09f9141.gif[/img]



- If you dropped or picked up money, the amount was not saved correctly
- MetaCrew missions were not saved correctly
- It happened that the siren song did not freeze the players
- Other minor bug fixes

[h2]Known issues:[/h2]

We are currently experiencing a bug where the game sometimes freezes when you click on "Leave Lobby" in the pause menu. This bug is known and is being investigated.

In addition, we have not yet been able to reproduce the bug that causes missions not to be displayed. In a few exceptions, this error also leads to the multiplayer not working. We were able to find out that the game does not connect to our server in such cases. If you are affected, we recommend that you add the game to the exceptions list of the Windows firewall and possibly other firewalls. It may also help to temporarily disable external anti-virus programs. Please write to us if you have this problem.

Unfortunately, the announced save system turned out to be more complex. This will be added later.


We hope you enjoy the new content! The next updates will focus more on bug fixes. 


We wish you a nice week!
<3
Dennis & Andre

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/3ac08f5b8cb90568209da27f0160251e77294802.png[/img]

According to traditional lore, vampires resemble revenants who leave their grave after death and can bring disaster to an entire village community.
To ensure that the deceased remained dead and did not become a vampire or strigoi, the human remains were often killed several times, body parts were cut off and then burned. Vampires feed on the blood and life force of the living.

[h1]A new map: St. Robert Smith Cemetery[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/d2c6d09e8006e99c26c40c858c4157d0a8c158e7.png[/img]

A small, modest cemetery dedicated to St. Robert Smith. The cemetery was established in the Middle Ages, but has lost little of its charm since then. It is a popular meeting place for the local drug and goth scene, a lost place in the midst of an increasingly fast-paced world.

notes.title: Big Bunker Update III
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/af99d144768f3ecb173a4d5d862592a4c55349ca.png[/img]

Hi guys!

We are glad to present you the new Big Bunker update.

This update completes the bunker with more cool features. Also, there are more features for the gameplay.  


[expand type=details]



[h1]Save the hostages![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/e2e702f5f427444b46b08080524f6f5e34744ce4.png[/img]

Depending on the map sometimes hostages will spawn. You can free them to get extra money. You free the hostage with a left click of the mouse (with empty hands). Then you have to eliminate the creature first and only then the hostage is considered to be rescued.
Note, however, that there is a small money penalty if you fail to free the hostage.


[h1]New bunker designs![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/58f811518df59f60bf52b25646c7455977a17a5d.png[/img]

Sometimes creatures will drop relics that you can pick up. 
You can collect these: already collected relics can now be found in the new relic room, which you can reach with the elevator. In this room you can also summon a new bunker design.
For such a bunker design you need 5 relics of the same kind. 
Each bunker design replaces Billy with a new NPC! 



[h1]Hunter's Crew![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/a5038a3a7f0b84bd55ee59f3e44c96b604986573.png[/img]

This new feature allows you to create your own crew. 
You can hire NPC hunters to hunt for you. 
Your hunters can level up and you can equip them.
When your hunters are recovering from a hunt or have nothing to do, they hang out in your bunker. Note, however, that they can also die during missions. For each successfully completed mission you will receive money and your hunters will receive experience points.


[h2]Changes:[/h2]

- it happened that the raven of the scarecrow did not want to disappear
- and other small bugfixes
[/expand]

We hope you will take pleasure in this update!


Best regards
Andre&Dennis

notes.title: Big items update and more
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/004c060c43d3193d31bb843a65ab107d2f5dbb3d.png[/img]

Hi guys,

we are glad to present you the new update. 
It contains 6 new items for creature identification. 
In addition, the update includes a new seasonal creature and new cool features (for example, you can cloak all the creatures you play against).



[expand type=details]

[h1]The new 6 items:[/h1]

[h1]Ouija board:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/7541c4ad97e089065d8d30202d7970b88df15d69.png[/img]

This is the instant messenger of the spirit world, so to speak. Whether you want to get in touch with your beloved deceased or have some fun with other dead people, the Ouija Board is as simple as it is effective. 
You can ask the creature questions and if it is in the same room, it will answer you.


[h1]Ghost doll:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/8bc3e9df9c1f1d0a12d1c79f211311bbe00b2f04.png[/img]

This cursed doll has been passed down from generation to generation and is used to allow certain creatures to take possession of it and move it. Since not all creatures are able to do this, this serves as evidence to identify a particular creature. 
If the creature is nearby, the puppet will start moving. 

[h1]Crystal Ball:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/ab9395ab1cff10ae55f762bd14c7c748689a8185.png[/img]

This crystal ball probably has its origins in ancient Germanic culture. It makes visible what otherwise remains hidden. Crystal ball can make visible past, present and future. This particular crystal ball was apparently created to make contact with one's ancestors. When touched by a creature, the crystal ball lights up. 


[h1]Statue of Mary:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/d2dae3232d47c7a1e4106e11c5831c546aa4cf8e.png[/img]

The statue of the Virgin Mary announces great calamity when she bleeds from her eyes. She warns you of malicious creatures and her blood is considered proof because not all creatures make her cry.
When the creature is near, the statue of Mary starts to bleed.

[h1]Candle:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/75bd95c6d3c212dd9b06fc52b8925faa6778009b.png[/img]

Candles are used to keep the spirit world away. Therefore, they do not enjoy great popularity among many creatures. Once the candle goes out, it is a clear indication of a metaphysical presence. 
If the creature is nearby, the candle will extinguish.

[h1]H2S meter:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/4a74347accafaab4c5df569090eacaab54021160.png[/img]

This measuring device is used to measure even the smallest amounts of hydrogen sulfide in the air. What was originally intended to locate a poisonous gas is used here to make typical sulfur odor detectable in the smallest concentration. Sulfur is said to have a direct connection to hell and therefore this meter is designed to detect demonic entities. 




[h1]The new seasonal creature: 
Fairy[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/5f02be60fcd5ebd588fe056daf253bbdef84a862.png[/img]

About fairies there are many different stories and myths. They are said to be good and close to the gods. They are described as noble and wise. Fairies are known to protect people and bring you blessings. But there are also some evil fairies described that can also be more powerful than the good ones.
The summer creature described here is one such evil fairy. She has the power to make herself invisible and to kidnap people by magic into her fairy world.

[h1]Additional modes: [/h1]

If you want a little more challenging mystery fun, this is not a problem. The following two features make the search for the supernatural a bit more difficult, regardless of the difficulty level you choose. 
These features were desired by the community.


Cloaking all creatures

The game has a number of creatures with unique appearance.
You now have the option to cloak all creatures you play against. This means that you cannot identify the creatures by their appearance. This also applies to the locations that certain creatures take you to.


Hardcore mode

With this you can eliminate all the evidence. The creatures will give you absolutely no evidence and you can identify them only by their behavior.
This mode is recommended for all players who have already expert knowledge of a large part of the creatures. 

[/expand]


We hope you like the update and wish you all a great week!

Dennis & Andre

notes.title: Big Map & Roles Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/9650b9027fbc433f8b769a4fe3f427bd59e3cee1.png[/img]

Hi guys,

we are happy to finally present you the new update! With this update you will get THREE new maps: from small to huge. There are FOUR new roles with very special abilities.

Of course we also made bugfixes and other changes. But we don't write them down in this changelog. Probably the most important change would be that you can use the Ghostbox with the Psychologist regardless of the room (the creature no longer needs to be in the same room to answer you if you are a Psychologist).



[expand type=details]

[h1]The new maps:[/h1]

[h1]Backwoods Cabin:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/ca44508b278d916d338f8ad02634ec22bbe200e5.png[/img]

This lonely forest cabin is located far from any civilization. This is good if you want to relax from the hectic everyday life in a big city. However, the nearest neighbors are very far away and so cries for help often fade into the darkness of the forest.


[h1]Nevergreen Terrace:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/17b20946b624cec9e248c554e3cd6dbbebb218a0.png[/img]

This family house is located in a small town. It is a quiet and idyllic place with its own nuclear power plant, which supplies electricity not only to the town but also to the surrounding area. The family house seems so familiar that you immediately feel comfortable and at home. But beware: every family has its secrets.

[h1]Nuttingham Castle:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/15fbc336fac92717553434d69db3a69d2fcb9759.png[/img]

This noble estate was built in the style of a baroque manor and has undergone several transformations over the generations. At the same time, the manor has always remained in the family of the Nuttinghams. The estate has its own cemetery, where the deceased members of the family rest.However, not all the deceased take it so exactly with the rest and do their creepy misbehavior. This place is famous for its ghost stories. So beware.


[h1]The new roles:[/h1]

[h1]The Witch:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/b94c54a411f77b8903463a564b3adb313cefc477.png[/img]

She can cast a protection spell on herself or teammates, allowing her to withstand another creature attack (usable 2x). In addition, her box allows her to cast incense sticks, which provoke the creature and immediately lead to a chase.

[h1]The Investigator: [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/fe7289260fe5191b0038fab8271d0855c0cca3ba.png[/img]

He has the ability to get a random proof of a creature's behavior. Also, he always sees fingerprints. So they do not disappear for him. His box allows a flashlight upgrade that makes the light beam larger.

[h1]The Druid: [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/d8aa461a41e34055740825eb060d6474878294e0.png[/img]

He has the ability to paint a mystical symbol on the ground. This symbol keeps all creatures away. His box allows you to drop a doll that attracts the creature's aggression, which protects the druid.

[h1]The half-demon: [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/a2fe66e6380db639cdf25be4291410ac51516c3f.png[/img]

When abducted by a creature, he can turn the tables and abduct the creature to hell himself. This offers him protection from the creature. His box allows him to drop a relic from Hell that attracts creatures outside of a hunt.

[/expand]


We hope you like the update and have a great week!

Dennis & Andre

Also, sometimes it happens that players get too many experience points and level up extremely fast. We are working on these bugs, but have not been able to reproduce them yet. notes.title: The big roll update is here! Version B 6.5
notes.content:
[h1]New features[/h1]

[h2]Role system[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/7a7d195fd7d561ed9cdf2ff0c37ac2bfa2cd8dc2.png[/img]

Players level 50 and above now have the option to choose one of six roles, allowing them to take advantage of individual benefits in missions.

[h3]The Doctor[/h3]
As a doctor, you can heal one of your teammates.

[h3]The Medium[/h3]
As a medium, you can contact the world of the deceased and locate the creature even if it is not hunting. You can also sense when a hunt is about to begin.

[h3]The Hunter[/h3]
As a hunter, you have more ammo in your shotgun and more HP.

[h3]The Prepper[/h3]
As a Prepper, you have more salt and chalk, plus your lighter lasts longer.

[h3]The Priest[/h3]
As a Priest, by the grace of God, you can exorcise without an exorcism book. Also, God's blessing gives you more HP. 

[h3]The Psychologist[/h3]
As a psychologist, you can take away the fear of your teammates and get scared slower yourself. This causes the creature to take longer to start a hunt.


Note that you can't change the role during a mission. So make sure you have chosen the role before starting the next mission. 
Each time you level up by 50 levels, you can unlock a new role. Once you have unlocked a role, you can't change your decision back.

Some of the roles have special abilities. Hold down "F" to activate them. 
You can find this feature in the Journal under the "Roles" bookmark.

[h2]Expert item skins[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012727/e3139e4854c1e38eacb4d5f3a29e735caa30d32a.png[/img]

Once you reach expert level 3 on a creature, you unlock a new skin for a specific item. You can find this feature in the Journal under the "Customization" bookmark.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
- Thermometer and lighter revised
- Salt pile revised (creatures that don't react to salt now leave a footprint)
- Journal revised and additional design added
- More sound effects
- You can now zoom with the camera while walking

notes.title: Update: Bugfixes and new features
notes.content:
sunday-update is out now!

bugfixes:

- Corrections of Translation in Russian
- No more magical duplication through the trunk (obejcts don't duplicate if you throw them back into the trunk)
- No more hangover in the main menu after drinking sake (the journal and other menus no longer vibrate)

new features:


- You can now check whether the exorcism book works correctly. Just take it out and start speaking (also works in the lobby). If the phrase is recognised the text colour changes to red. If there's a trapped creature around the line will turn back black and be crossed out. Otherwise it just changes back to black after two seconds.
- the pentagram now indicates whether a creature is trapped inside. You will also be able to see whether the pentagram is still functioning or whether it lost its functionality (the pentagram can hold the creature only for some time [120 sec] and will be unusable afterwards)

- Overhaul GUI
- you now keep the clothes you buy and can change your outfit in the mainmenu/lobby
- money and xp can now only be earned if you identified the creature or if you eliminated the creature

Cheers
Dennis

notes.title: Update: Changes under the hood + your suggestions
notes.content:
Hey, it's still Thursday in Germany ;)

We have now released the new update for this week.

[b]Change Log[/b]

[u]features:[/u]

- the aggression of the creature is now also increasing when you don't have your radio on while talking to it 
- changed start balance of players from 400,- to 700,- to make it easier during the first missions
